item.title: Version 1.0.1
item.description:
What's New in 1.0.1

  • Initial Production Release of Tigle Ledger Online.
  • Double-entry commercial wholesale bazaar accounting (Jama / Banam).
  • Offline-first Drift SQLite architecture with cloud synchronization.
  • Dual-currency Daybook, Cash Drawer (Rokarr), and Party Ledgers.
  • Dedicated Creditors (TotalCr) and Debtors (TotalDr) PDF and Print registers.
